incidents.name: mUSDY flashLoan exchange-rate reentrancy
incidents.notes: The mUSDY market's ERC-3156 flashLoan() ran the borrower callback while the market's cash balance was still reduced, so lending USDY back inside the callback minted mTokens at an inflated exchange rate; 24 repetitions built collateral used to borrow WETH and mETH.

sources.ref: onchain review: mUSDY proxy 0x5edbd880... (symbol mUSDY, comptroller 0x8...) created by 0x66f850099e6d5dbd712d15244b65bd822f36be7e on 2024-01-23; two EIP-1967 Upgraded events, the last 2024-02-22 to impl 0x4b351368459ccc0024197d24ab7ba278e4c6f510
